goal: Ignore duplicate -addnode startup values to match the deduplication applied by runtime RPC calls
Prevents redundant DNS lookups, repeated connection retries, and cluttered node info logs
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no blocking dependencies or pending reworks
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified deduplication behavior on regtest with default port (AndreaDiazCorreia)
Support for deduplicating startup values and port equivalence (danielabrozzoni, pablomartin4btc)
Suggestion to log matched target when duplicate is rejected (pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because redundant connection retries and DNS lookups only occur when users configure duplicate entries
Benefit is limited to node operators who specify duplicate manual connection targets at startup
